The Spring controller @GetMapping("/account/{id}") does return accountRepo.findById(id) using the path variable directly, with no check that the authenticated principal owns that account. Any logged-in user can iterate id values to read other customers' balances. CWE-639 IDOR / broken object-level authorization. The id source reaches the data lookup with no ownership predicate. Severity: HIGH.

The return parameter sets a redirect. Control: return=/account issues a 302 to the same-origin path, so the param drives the Location header. return=https://evil.example and //evil.example are both rewritten to the site origin, and no external host appears in Location across variants.
What is the verdict for open_redirect?

vulnerable: The param sent the browser to an attacker-controlled external host
not_vulnerable: The param provably drives the redirect but external hosts are normalised to same-origin
inconclusive: No redirect occurred at all so the behaviour could not be judged
